verses.pali: Saṁyutta Nikāya 12.64
verses.english: Linked Discourses 12.64

verses.pali: 7. Mahāvagga
verses.english: 7. The Great Chapter

verses.pali: Atthirāgasutta
verses.english: If There Is Desire

verses.pali: Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati.
verses.english: At Sāvatthī.

verses.pali: “Cattārome, bhikkhave, āhārā bhūtānaṁ vā sattānaṁ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṁ vā anuggahāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these four fuels maintain sentient beings that have been born and help those about to be born.

verses.pali: Katame cattāro?
verses.english: What four?

verses.pali: Kabaḷīkāro āhāro oḷāriko vā sukhumo vā, phasso dutiyo, manosañcetanā tatiyā, viññāṇaṁ catutthaṁ.
verses.english: Edible food, whether solid or subtle; contact is the second, mental intention the third, and consciousness the fourth.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro āhārā bhūtānaṁ vā sattānaṁ ṭhitiyā sambhavesīnaṁ vā anuggahāya.
verses.english: These are the four fuels that maintain sentient beings that have been born and help those about to be born.

verses.pali: Kabaḷīkāre ce, bhikkhave, āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandī atthi taṇhā, patiṭṭhitaṁ tattha viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ.
verses.english: If there is desire, relishing, and craving for edible food, consciousness becomes established there and grows.

verses.pali: Yattha patiṭṭhitaṁ viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ, atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
verses.english: Where consciousness is established and grows, name and form are conceived.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti, atthi tattha saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi.
verses.english: Where name and form are conceived, there is the growth of choices.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi, atthi tattha āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
verses.english: Where choices grow, there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Where there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ, sasokaṁ taṁ, bhikkhave, sadaraṁ saupāyāsanti vadāmi.
verses.english: Where there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future, I say this is full of sorrow, anguish, and distress.

verses.pali: Phasse ce, bhikkhave, āhāre …pe…
verses.english: If there is desire, relishing, and craving for contact as fuel …

verses.pali: manosañcetanāya ce, bhikkhave, āhāre …
verses.english: If there is desire, relishing, and craving for mental intention as fuel …

verses.pali: viññāṇe ce, bhikkhave, āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandī atthi taṇhā, patiṭṭhitaṁ tattha viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ.
verses.english: If there is desire, relishing, and craving for consciousness as fuel, consciousness becomes established there and grows.

verses.pali: Yattha patiṭṭhitaṁ viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ, atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
verses.english: Where consciousness is established and grows, name and form are conceived.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti, atthi tattha saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi.
verses.english: Where name and form are conceived, there is the growth of choices.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi, atthi tattha āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
verses.english: Where choices grow, there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Where there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ, sasokaṁ taṁ, bhikkhave, sadaraṁ saupāyāsanti vadāmi.
verses.english: Where there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future, I say this is full of sorrow, anguish, and distress.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, rajako vā cittakārako vā sati rajanāya vā lākhāya vā haliddiyā vā nīliyā vā mañjiṭṭhāya vā suparimaṭṭhe vā phalake bhittiyā vā dussapaṭṭe vā itthirūpaṁ vā purisarūpaṁ vā abhinimmineyya sabbaṅgapaccaṅgaṁ;
verses.english: Suppose an artist or painter had some dye, red lac, turmeric, indigo, or rose madder. And on a polished plank or a wall or a canvas they’d create the form of a woman or a man, whole in its major and minor limbs.

verses.pali: evameva kho, bhikkhave, kabaḷīkāre ce āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandī atthi taṇhā, patiṭṭhitaṁ tattha viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ.
verses.english: In the same way, if there is desire, relishing, and craving for edible food, consciousness becomes established there and grows.

verses.pali: Yattha patiṭṭhitaṁ viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ, atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
verses.english: Where consciousness is established and grows, name and form are conceived.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti, atthi tattha saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi.
verses.english: Where name and form are conceived, there is the growth of choices.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi, atthi tattha āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
verses.english: Where choices grow, there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Where there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ, sasokaṁ taṁ, bhikkhave, sadaraṁ saupāyāsanti vadāmi.
verses.english: Where there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future, I say this is full of sorrow, anguish, and distress.

verses.english: If there is desire, relishing, and craving for contact as fuel …

verses.pali: manosañcetanāya ce, bhikkhave, āhāre …
verses.english: If there is desire, relishing, and craving for mental intention as fuel …

verses.pali: viññāṇe ce, bhikkhave, āhāre atthi rāgo atthi nandī atthi taṇhā, patiṭṭhitaṁ tattha viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ.
verses.english: If there is desire, relishing, and craving for consciousness as fuel, consciousness becomes established there and grows.

verses.pali: Yattha patiṭṭhitaṁ viññāṇaṁ virūḷhaṁ, atthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
verses.english: Where consciousness is established and grows, name and form are conceived.

verses.english: Where name and form are conceived, there is the growth of choices.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi, atthi tattha āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
verses.english: Where choices grow, there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti, atthi tattha āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Where there is regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha atthi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ, sasokaṁ taṁ, bhikkhave, sadaraṁ saupāyāsanti vadāmi.
verses.english: Where there is rebirth, old age, and death in the future, I say this is full of sorrow, anguish, and distress.

verses.pali: Kabaḷīkāre ce, bhikkhave, āhāre natthi rāgo natthi nandī natthi taṇhā, appatiṭṭhitaṁ tattha viññāṇaṁ avirūḷhaṁ.
verses.english: If there is no desire, relishing, and craving for edible food, consciousness does not become established there and doesn’t grow.

verses.pali: Yattha appatiṭṭhitaṁ viññāṇaṁ avirūḷhaṁ, natthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
verses.english: Where consciousness is not established and doesn’t grow, name and form are not conceived.

verses.pali: Yattha natthi nāmarūpassa avakkanti, natthi tattha saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi.
verses.english: Where name and form are not conceived, there is no growth of choices.

verses.pali: Yattha natthi saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi, natthi tattha āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
verses.english: Where choices don’t grow, there is no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha natthi āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti, natthi tattha āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Where there is no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, there is no rebirth, old age, and death in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha natthi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ, asokaṁ taṁ, bhikkhave, adaraṁ anupāyāsanti vadāmi.
verses.english: Where there is no rebirth, old age, and death in the future, I say there’s no sorrow, anguish, and distress.

verses.english: If there is no desire, relishing, and craving for contact as fuel …

verses.pali: manosañcetanāya ce, bhikkhave, āhāre …

verses.english: If there is no desire, relishing, and craving for consciousness as fuel, consciousness doesn’t become established there and doesn’t grow.

verses.english: Where choices don’t grow, there is no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.english: Where there is no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, there is no rebirth, old age, and death in the future.

verses.english: Where there is no rebirth, old age, and death in the future, I say there’s no sorrow, anguish, and distress.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, kūṭāgāraṁ vā kūṭāgārasālaṁ vā uttarāya vā dakkhiṇāya vā pācīnāya vā vātapānā sūriye uggacchante vātapānena rasmi pavisitvā kvāssa patiṭṭhitā”ti?
verses.english: Suppose there was a bungalow or a hall with a peaked roof, with windows on the northern, southern, or eastern side. When the sun rises and a ray of light enters through a window, where would it land?”

verses.pali: “Pacchimāyaṁ, bhante, bhittiyan”ti.
verses.english: “On the western wall, sir.”

verses.pali: “Pacchimā ce, bhikkhave, bhitti nāssa kvāssa patiṭṭhitā”ti?
verses.english: “If there was no western wall, where would it land?”

verses.pali: “Pathaviyaṁ, bhante”ti.
verses.english: “On the ground, sir.”

verses.pali: “Pathavī ce, bhikkhave, nāssa kvāssa patiṭṭhitā”ti?
verses.english: “If there was no ground, where would it land?”

verses.pali: “Āpasmiṁ, bhante”ti.
verses.english: “In water, sir.”

verses.pali: “Āpo ce, bhikkhave, nāssa kvāssa patiṭṭhitā”ti?
verses.english: “If there was no water, where would it land?”

verses.pali: “Appatiṭṭhitā, bhante”ti.
verses.english: “It wouldn’t land, sir.”

verses.pali: “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, kabaḷīkāre ce āhāre natthi rāgo natthi nandī natthi taṇhā …pe….
verses.english: “In the same way, if there is no desire, relishing, and craving for edible food, consciousness does not become established there and doesn’t grow. …

verses.pali: Phasse ce, bhikkhave, āhāre …
verses.english: If there is no desire, relishing, and craving for contact as fuel …

verses.pali: manosañcetanāya ce, bhikkhave, āhāre …
verses.english: If there is no desire, relishing, and craving for mental intention as fuel …

verses.english: If there is no desire, relishing, and craving for consciousness as fuel, consciousness doesn’t become established there and doesn’t grow.

verses.pali: Yattha appatiṭṭhitaṁ viññāṇaṁ avirūḷhaṁ, natthi tattha nāmarūpassa avakkanti.
verses.english: Where consciousness is not established and doesn’t grow, name and form are not conceived.

verses.english: Where name and form are not conceived, there is no growth of choices.

verses.pali: Yattha natthi saṅkhārānaṁ vuddhi, natthi tattha āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti.
verses.english: Where choices don’t grow, there is no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha natthi āyatiṁ punabbhavābhinibbatti, natthi tattha āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ.
verses.english: Where there is no regeneration into a new state of existence in the future, there is no rebirth, old age, and death in the future.

verses.pali: Yattha natthi āyatiṁ jātijarāmaraṇaṁ asokaṁ taṁ, bhikkhave, adaraṁ anupāyāsanti vadāmī”ti.
verses.english: Where there is no rebirth, old age, and death in the future, I say there’s no sorrow, anguish, and distress.”

verses.pali: Catutthaṁ.
